title: Chain-of-Thought Controllability Can Reduce Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
description:
arXiv:2611.21799v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents. One risk is that models could deliberately shape their reasoning to make it opaque to monitors. We stress-test this risk through persona-control training: supervised fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning traces rewritten in the voices of diverse personas.
